description.value:
♓ Pisces is ascendant today. Your Cloth is awake and you have your Ascendant Boon for the whole day.

You radiate a 10-foot emanation of roses. At the end of each of your turns, up to four enemies in it must each attempt a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC or take @Damage[4d6[poison]] damage and be enfeebled 1 (cumulative to enfeebled 4).

The garden requires that you acted hostilely that turn, and it persists even while you are unconscious.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Ascendant Constellation]. Applied and removed by the module's sky tracker; a GM can also drag it on by hand.
